calls.statement:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dt, status, fulfilment_type, count(*) n
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE dispatch_ts_utc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3),
o AS (
  SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dt, count(*) orders, sum(CASE WHEN status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) canc, sum(CASE WHEN status='processing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) proc
  FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1)
SELECT o.dt, dayname(o.dt) dow, o.orders, o.canc, o.proc,
 (SELECT sum(n) FROM d WHERE d.dt=o.dt) dispatched,
 (SELECT sum(n) FROM d WHERE d.dt=o.dt AND fulfilment_type='click_and_collect') cc_dispatched
FROM o WHERE o.dt BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-08' AND DATE '2025-12-28' ORDER BY 1

WITH w AS (
  SELECT o.web_order_id, o.status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) dd
  FROM fact_web_order o WHERE o.status IN ('delivered','collected')
   AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23')
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM w) orders,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM w WHERE web_order_id NOT IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line)) no_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) dup_receipt_line,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) dup_line_id,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id<>900) web_lines_not_900,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE p.category='ZZ Test') test_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE f.staff_purchase_flag) staff_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23') returns900,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) dup_returns

SELECT count(*) lines, sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)-f.gross_amount)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vat_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) loads, min(f.etl_loaded_at), max(f.etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
